name: Path-Based Obfuscation
description: Reframes the explicit undirected triangle (3-clique) detection into finding a "bypassed two-step sequence" in a directed acyclic graph. This forces models to parse the structural path condition rather than relying on explicit `a < b < c` inequalities and direct triangle edge checks, likely causing them to either fail to extract the exact conditions or implement a naive path search that TLEs.
